name: r5-e1-cutlass-evt-tf32
author: solx-loop
description: H30 tested and REFUTED. The CUTLASS 4.4.1 sm100 builder can carry the whole GEMM1 epilogue as an EVT: LN fold via ColBroadcast(-mean, rstd) and RowBroadcast(u, v), exact erf GELU, hidden store, and the per-image GRN sum of squares as a non-final RowReduction with a custom a+b*b reducer. TF32 operands read straight from fp32 memory round to nearest. But the per-image-batched TF32 GEMM1 costs 17.0 us cold at 8,768 and 20.0 us at 8,384, against the 14 / 12 us kill lines.
